from collections import defaultdict

# Use existing access_token from prior step by re-login (safe)
spotify_password = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='spotify'][0]['password']
login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='joyce-weav@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

# Fetch all playlists (all pages)
page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
all_playlists = []
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if isinstance(resp, dict) and 'message' in resp:
        raise RuntimeError(resp['message'])
    if not resp:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

# Collect unique song ids from all playlists
song_id_set = set()
playlist_song_map = {}
for pl in all_playlists:
    ids = pl.get('song_ids') or []
    playlist_song_map[pl['playlist_id']] = ids
    song_id_set.update(ids)

print('playlists:', len(all_playlists))
print('unique_song_ids:', len(song_id_set))
print('song_ids_sample:', sorted(list(song_id_set))[:20])

spotify_password = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='spotify'][0]['password']
login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='joyce-weav@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

# fetch all playlists (all pages)
page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
all_playlists = []
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if isinstance(resp, dict) and 'message' in resp:
        raise RuntimeError(resp['message'])
    if not resp:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

song_id_set = set()
for pl in all_playlists:
    for sid in (pl.get('song_ids') or []):
        song_id_set.add(sid)

song_ids = sorted(song_id_set)
print('computing likes for unique song count:', len(song_ids))

song_like_records = []
for sid in song_ids:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    title = s.get('title')
    like_count = s.get('like_count')
    song_like_records.append((like_count, sid, title))

# find max like_count
max_like = max(r[0] for r in song_like_records)
candidates = [r for r in song_like_records if r[0]==max_like]
# deterministic pick: smallest song_id
candidates_sorted = sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: x[1])
print('max_like_count:', max_like)
print('candidate_count:', len(candidates_sorted))
print('top_candidates:', candidates_sorted[:10])
print('selected_title:', candidates_sorted[0][2])
